title.narrative: China: Qinghai Xining Urban Transport Project

description.narrative: The objective of the Qinghai Xining Urban Transport Project for China is to enable Xining residents to travel between the city center and the western part of Xining City in a fast, efficient, and safe manner, through strategic improvements to Wusixi road, a major transport and urban development corridor. The project consists of the following components: 1) urban roads; 2) public transport; 3) intelligent traffic management; and 4) institutional capacity building. The first component deals with financing construction of three short road sections which are part of the proposed integrated public transport corridor and are necessary for providing good quality public transport services in the newly developed Xichuan district in the west of the city. The second component finances improvements to public transport infrastructure, operations, and complementary facilities on the proposed integrated public transport corridor on Wusixi road. The third component finances the development of an intelligent traffic management system in support of the proposed integrated public transport corridor on Wusixi road, while the final component improves the city's institutional capacity for urban transport planning and management through financing specific activities.

The proposed Project Development Objective (PDO) is to enable Xining residents to travel between the city center and the western part of the city in a fast, efficient, and safe manner, through strategic improvements to Wusixi Road, a major transport and urban development corridor.

condition.narrative: Finance Agreement :Financial management | Description :Qinghai Province shall furnish the audited financial statements to the Banknot later than six months after the end of each fiscal year. | Frequency :Yearly

Finance Agreement :Implementation arrangements | Description :Qinghai Province shall maintain throughout the period ofimplementation of the Project an organizational structure with composition, powers, functions, funds, staffing, facilities andother resources satisfactory to the Bank. | Frequency :CONTINUOUS

Finance Agreement :Implementation plan | Description :Qinghai Province shall cause Xining Municipality to prepare and furnish tothe Bank by November 30 in each year, starting from 2014, an annual implementation plan, summarizing the implementation progress ofthe Project for the said year and the Project activitiesto be undertaken for the following calendar year. | Frequency :Yearly

Finance Agreement :Reporting | Description :Qinghai Province shall, and shall cause Xining Municipality to monitor and evaluate theprogress of the Project and prepare semi-annual Project Reports, including project indicators by March 15 and September 15 in eachyear, starting from September 15, 2014. | Frequency :SemiAnnual

Finance Agreement :Safeguards | Description :Qinghai Province shall implement, or shall cause the Xining Municipality or itsagencies to implement the EMP, the RAP and the RPF in a manner and substance satisfactory to the Bank. | Frequency :CONTINUOUS

comment.narrative: <p>The original indicator at appraisal was "Length of urban roads constructed" in kilometers, and the target was 8 km in light of the original scope, Xicheng Avenue, Wusixi Road, and Road No. 5, aggregated. The 2019 restructuring expanded the scope to include: Qiyi Road, Qiyi Road, Delingha Road, Bayi Road, and Wuyi Road. The restructuring also revised the indicator to "Percentage of constructed road quantities", disaggregated by segment and reflecting the updated project scope and timeline. The targets were achieved for all road segments at the project closing.</p>

title.narrative: Number of image forensic systems for road traffic offenses installed and in use on project corridor

comment.narrative: <p>At appraisal, the indicator was "Number of traffic enforcement cameras installed" with the target of 98. The 2019 restructuring revised the indicator to "E-police enforcement cameras" and increase the target to 111, reflecting the progress of investment design while moving the target date to the new closing date. As of project closing, the indicator exceeded the target.</p>
<p>The 2019 restructuring revised the target date to reflect the project closing date, by which time the indicator met the target.</p>

title.narrative: Average travel time of public transport useres during the morning peak period on weekdays on the project corridor

comment.narrative: <p>The indicator was disaggregated into sub-indicators by segment: Haihu Road to Changjiang Road (original scope) and Changjiang Road to Jianguo Street (added scope) during 2019 restructuring. The target value was revised to 18(15.4 in PAD) for the original segment based on the actual condition. The target was achieved for both segments. </p>

title.narrative: Percentage of public transport users satisfied on the project corridor

comment.narrative: <p>At appraisal, the indicator was "Higher satisfaction rating by public transport users on the project corridor" in score out of 5, with the target of 3.75 for both male and female. The 2019 restructuring revised the indicator as "Percentage of public transport users satisfied on the project corridor" in percentage, defining the users satisfied as those who responded 4 and 5 on a 5-score scale (1 the lowest and 5 the highest). The restructuring revised the target value to 85 percent for both male and female and the date to the revised project closing date. As of project closing, the indicator achieved the target (85.4 percent for male passengers; 85.2 percent for female passengers).</p>

title.narrative: number of people killed and seriously injured on wusixi road (xining rd to tonghai rd)

comment.narrative: <p>At appraisal, the indicator was "Reduced annual number of transport related injuries and fatalities on the project corridor" in number per km. The 2019 restructuring revised the indicator to "Number of people killed and seriously injuries on Wusixi Road (Xinning Rd to Tonghai Rd)" with clarified definitions of serious injuries and fatalities associated with traffic accidents to reflect good practices. The restructuring also updated the target value and date. The target has been achieved by the project closing.</p>

title.narrative: Public transport beneficiaries from the project corridor

comment.narrative: <p>At appraisal, the indicator was "Increased daily public transport users on the project corridor" in persons, defined as "Daily public transport users on Wusixi Road on the weekdays" without clear definition of persons, corridor, timebound, among others. The 2019 restructuring refined the indicator as "Public transport beneficiaries from the project corridor" in person-trips, with sub-indicators by segment (2-1 Haihu Road to Changjiang Road, and; 2-2 Changjiang Road to Jianguo Street). The restructuring improved the methodology and revised the target values and dates accordingly. The target value was revised to 640,000 (704,000 in the PAD) for the original segment based on the actual condition during the restructuring. At project closing, the targets were fully achieved for both segments..</p>

title.narrative: percentage of jobs accesibile within a 45 minute commute using non-private transport (PT and walking) after the improvement of the project corridor

comment.narrative: <p>At appraisal, "number of jobs accessible along Wusixi Road" in number was an intermediate indicator under Component Two: Public Transport. The baseline value was 146,800 in 2013, and the target value was 189,400 in 2019. The 2019 restructuring changed the accessibility indicator to a PDO indicator that measures "efficient" aspect, with a refined and clarified methodology as the percentage of accessible jobs along the corridor and the target value of 82.67 percent. By the project closing, the indicator value was 83.63 percent, having achieved the target.</p>

title.narrative: ChinaRAP rating of road safety risks on project roads

comment.narrative: <p>To fully analyze the safety aspect, the 2019 restructuring added this indicator. At the project closing, the targets for all four road segments were fully achieved. </p>
